auth.verify.trustHint: Only on a device that isn't shared with others.
auth.verify.invalid: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds, so enter the one showing now.
auth.verify.backupBody: Use one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step sign-in. Each code works once.
auth.verify.expired: Your sign-in timed out. Sign in again.
auth.verify.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account
mfa.title: Set up two-step sign-in
mfa.intro: Every eMazeBrain staff account is protected by a code from an authenticator app as well as your password. It takes about two minutes.
mfa.step1.title: Confirm your password
mfa.step1.apps: You'll need an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
mfa.step2.title: Scan the QR code
mfa.step2.body: In your authenticator app, add an account and scan this code.
mfa.step2.qrAlt: QR code that adds eMazeBrain to an authenticator app
mfa.step2.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead
mfa.step3.title: Save your backup codes
mfa.step3.body: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
mfa.file.header: eMazeBrain backup codes for {email}. Each code works once.
